_note: Per-population rate thresholds (Hz), set by scripts/calibrate_thresholds.py from the pre-registered policy in config/thresholds_policy.yaml: each is a quantile of that population's rate over the named set of real windows, floored at min_hz. Never from outcomes, never hand-set. `_calibration.source` names the ledger each came from; `_calibration.kept` lists any left at their previous value for want of windows.
